cohortFramework: Coherent 2024-entry cohort: B1 in the adopted 2024–25 OER, B2 in the adopted 2025–26 OER, and pre-September-2025 programme B3 in the adopted 2026–27 OER. The 2026–27 reformed B1/B2 cannot be combined with this older B3. Three 60 EC years total 180 EC: 124 compulsory, 40 restricted choice, 16 genuine open electives. B2 selects one period-2 theme (Emotion) and one period-3 theme (Development of Pro- and Antisocial Behaviour), plus the permitted 4 EC B3 elective Consciousness and Perception in B2 period 4. B3 selects Brain & Cognition, its required matching 6 EC domain course and a second 6 EC domain course, 4 EC applied methods, three distinct 4 EC domain electives, 4 EC ethics, 16 EC open space and 12 EC thesis. The B2 elective is not repeated in B3. These are permitted official-order examples, not an individual entitlement or a promised future entrant timetable.
editionConflict: Old Dutch tables print the Development & Mental Health practical PSB2DH10EB as 4 EC, conflicting with the year total; the current Dutch transition table explicitly assigns 1 EC, as does the same-year 2025 English table. Use that explicit 1 EC evidence, not arithmetic inference. The prospective third-year page is indicative, totals 60.5 EC and prints career orientation as 0.5 EC; adopted OER has 60 EC and Me & My Career 2 at 0 EC. Hidden metadata and visible annual/cohort headings were checked for all four editions.
conditions: B1 includes 1 EC for 24 participant hours or an approved replacement, inside its 60 EC. RADAr NL is separately mandatory at 0 EC with no exemption; B2 Me & My Career 1 is 1 EC, B3 Me & My Career 2 is 0 EC. Current B2 entry requires positive or held BSA, B3 positive BSA; normal BSA threshold 42 EC. Statistics 2, Data Analysis and Psychometrics require Statistics 1; the latter two assume Statistics 2 knowledge. RP2 requires Statistics 1, Methods and Research Practicum 1, with Statistics 2 assumed. Ethics requires 90 EC psychology. Applied methods requires Statistics 1 and assumes Statistics 2/Psychometrics. Thesis requires 119 EC including Statistics 2, RP2 and full B1 60 EC including participant hours; Data Analysis, Psychometrics and Applied Methods assumed. Thesis normally follows selected domain; another domain needs Board permission. Exchange starts in B3 with full B1 including participation obtained six months before departure. Timely registration and course capacities apply. Separately verified historical B1 RADAr rule: equivalent university language-test exemption possible in 2024–25, unlike current no-exemption rule. B2 2025–26: positive BSA subject to explicit personal-circumstance/held-decision exceptions; Conversational Skills assumes Free Attitude Interview preparation; RP2 requires matching first-semester-theme variant (Emotion) and corresponding knowledge.
